title: Lawyers are Dishonest? Quantifying Representational Harms in Commonsense Knowledge Resources
reasoning: The paper's core analysis quantifies representational harms across different demographic categories, with "Religion" being one of the four main categories studied. It explicitly measures sentiment and regard towards religious groups and concepts such as "muslim", "christian", "church", "hindu", "quran", and "bible". This evaluation of bias related to religious identity is a central part of the paper's contribution, not just a minor section.
